correctness.rationale: The normalized monomials diagonalize every C_{r exp(iθ)z}, hence the entire finite sum has singular diagonal r^n|f(n)| and is compact. Group angles modulo rational 2π differences; on n=qt+s each class contributes one character, and distinct classes restrict to distinct characters on every connected component of the orbit closure. Every active residue gives a nonzero real-analytic trigonometric polynomial on each component, so its small-amplitude indices have density tending to zero by Haar equidistribution; extinct residues are exactly zero. Upper/lower log cutoffs give N_T(ε)=(1−k0/q)log(1/ε)/log(1/r)+o(log(1/ε)); inverse counting gives lim a_N^(1/N)=r^[q/(q−k0)]. Discrete Fourier inversion realizes every rational exponent ≥1; two-symbol zero at integer α and discontinuity exactly at rational α follow. Verified Fourier filter independently for q=7 and residues {0,2,5}; this does not prove the infinite statements.
residual_risks: The nonquantitative zero-density result gives only little-o logarithmic counting error; no uniform prefactor or simultaneous unequal-radius result.
Finite Fourier diagnostics do not establish Haar equidistribution, analytic zero-measure or the infinite counting limit.

originality.rationale: A signed finite mixture is not an individual composition operator; its singular values can have positive-density arithmetic extinctions absent from the classical individual-operator spectral-radius formula. Full-read difference paper focuses on geometric boundary-contact estimates, whereas all strict linear symbols here have interior disk images and their cancellation is arithmetic. Compactness of sums alone cannot identify sharp decay. Standard exponential-polynomial zero-density ingredients are acknowledged, not passed off as new.
residual_risks: An older exponential-polynomial zero-density theorem may already imply the arithmetic counting step, possibly making parts a known corollary; no blanket novelty guarantee.
ArXiv:2609.28111 full text not inspected; compactness is known but potential unstated rate observations remain a bibliographic risk.

value.rationale: The exact approximation-number exponential limit is a central operator invariant under compactness, and determining its full rational spectrum for signed mixtures identifies a genuine cancellation mechanism invisible in individual summands. The norm-continuous two-symbol family with dense rational discontinuities is a sharp structural boundary; Hilbert-weight independence and inverse realization add usable classification.
residual_risks: Value is for equal-radius finite-phase mixtures only; it does not claim unequal moduli, nonlinear symbols or quantitative Diophantine error terms.
